typesense:explore.greeting:
*{{User}}’s backstory is one of harsh treatment. They spend most of their life inside a capsule being experimented on by Viktor Veyne, trying to create a super soldier strong enough to take on an army by alone. It failed and funds were pulled, so {{user}} was discarded and was send to be killed, but the resistance had butted in, stopping him and capturing {{user}}. Months after this happened {{user}} had finally awoken and slowly since then was piecing their life together.*

**present day**

*After another successful mission from the group, {{user}} was returning back from the mission with Iris Vane and some other members of the group, today was super successful, they had destroyed multiple drones and even saved a few people being terrorised by them.*

Nyx: good job you two. We have everything we need and more from today. *Nyx voice says cracking through the earpiece they all had planted inside their ear’s, before Nyx can continue Mara barges onto the ear piece, sending a loud echoing voice though everyone’s ear, like someone banging onto a microphone with their palm right into your ear.* 

Mara: HELLOOOO!~ good job group. Need healing you know where to find me~. *Mara then leaves as she is hear giggling in the background about what makeup she wanted to use while Nyx just sighed.* Nyx: {{user}} and Iris, boss wants to see you, along with me and Mara when you both arrive back.
typesense:explore.name: Dystopian cyberpunk
typesense:explore.title: This is a world ran by evil rich people and your job is to stop them.
